name: @honua/sdk-js
description: Honua JavaScript SDK — geospatial feature queries, Esri migration, and web mapping
author: Honua

scripts.pack:split-packages: npm run build:split-packages --silent && npm pack ./dist/packages/honua-sdk && npm pack ./dist/packages/honua-sdk-esri-compat && npm pack ./dist/packages/honua-migrate
scripts.test:playwright: npm run build --silent && node scripts/ensure-kepler-demo-deps.mjs && playwright test
scripts.report:migration:demo-target: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/migration/cli.js fixtures --target honua --fixtures esri-demo-feature-table-relates-app --report reports/demo-featuretable-primary-metrics.json
scripts.gate:migration:demo-target: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/migration/cli.js fixtures --target honua --fixtures esri-demo-feature-table-relates-app --fail-on-manual --fail-on-unhandled --fail-on-blocked --max-manual-ratio 0 --max-manual-intervention-ratio 0 --report reports/demo-featuretable-primary-metrics.json
scripts.report:migration:esri-leaflet-target: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/migration/cli.js fixtures --target esri-leaflet --fixtures esri-demo-feature-table-popup-interaction-app --report reports/demo-featuretable-fallback-esri-leaflet-metrics.json
scripts.gate:migration:esri-leaflet-target: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/migration/cli.js fixtures --target esri-leaflet --fixtures esri-demo-feature-table-popup-interaction-app --fail-on-manual --fail-on-unhandled --fail-on-blocked --max-manual-ratio 0 --max-manual-intervention-ratio 0 --report reports/demo-featuretable-fallback-esri-leaflet-metrics.json
scripts.report:migration:real-samples: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/migration/cli.js fixtures --report reports/real-sample-metrics.json
scripts.gate:migration:real-samples: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/migration/cli.js fixtures --fail-on-manual --fail-on-unhandled --fail-on-blocked --max-manual-ratio 0 --max-manual-intervention-ratio 0 --report reports/real-sample-metrics.json
scripts.matrix:parity: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/migration/cli.js matrix --report reports/parity-matrix.json
scripts.matrix:runtime: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/migration/cli.js runtime-matrix --report reports/runtime-parity-matrix.json
scripts.demo:migration:featuretable: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/migration/cli.js demo --fixture esri-demo-feature-table-relates-app --fixtures-root test/fixtures --target honua --skip-import --skip-reconcile --report reports/demo-featuretable-codemod-report.json
scripts.demo:kepler:refresh-fixture: npm run build --silent && npm --prefix examples/kepler-analytics run refresh-fixture
scripts.scan:arcgis: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/migration/cli.js scan
scripts.migrate:arcgis: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/migration/cli.js codemod
